entities.summary: Kamil Semeniuk is a Polish professional volleyball player who plays as an outside hitter for Sir Safety Perugia and the Poland national team. Semeniuk won silver medal at the 2024 Summer Olympics. He is also a silver medallist at the 2022 World Championship, and a three–time Champions League winner with ZAKSA and Perugia.
